# stalwart_domains (Data Source)

Lists the identifiers of all `x:Domain` objects on the server.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "stalwart_domains" "all" {}

data "stalwart_domain" "each" {
  for_each = data.stalwart_domains.all.ids

  id = each.value
}

output "domain_names" {
  value = [for domain in data.stalwart_domain.each : domain.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `ids` (Set of String) Identifiers of all objects of this type.
